keyPoints.en: Chordophone (strings — plucked, bowed, struck): sape, rebab, gambus, guitar, violin.
keyPoints.bm: Kordofon (tali — dipetik, digesek, dipalu): sape, rebab, gambus, gitar, biola.

keyPoints.en: Idiophone (body vibrates): gong, angklung, kulintangan, caklempong.
keyPoints.bm: Idiofon (badan bergetar): gong, angklung, kulintangan, caklempong.

tip.en: Ask "what vibrates?" — not "how is it played?".

keyPoints.en: Ensembles combine instruments; bigger or longer parts give lower pitch.
keyPoints.bm: Ensembel menggabungkan alat muzik; bahagian yang lebih besar atau panjang menghasilkan pic lebih rendah.
